tasks.title: Admin bearer check accepts a fabricated admin id

The audited memory and support-plan reads now require role super_admin or admin. batch3-admin-disclosure.spec.ts 1.7-1.12 cover the old fabricated format, a tampered signature, expiry, a missing secret, a non-admin role, and the positive case; 12/12 pass.

tasks.title: Baseline gate scope: a selected-spec run could poison the record
tasks.evidence: First attempt (f352429) was defective: the write condition used /D/g instead of /\D/g, so Number('files:37') was NaN, the record was never written again, and the previous-run comparison was inert. Fixed in 9146413 with an explicit parseScopeFileCount() and nine unit tests in tests/unit/baseline-diff.spec.ts. Reverse proof: restoring the old expression fails four named tests. The stale files:1 record was repaired to files:37 by re-running the gate.

tasks.title: The mutation harness exits non-zero when any mutation does not reach PROVEN
tasks.evidence: A mutation that never reached PROVEN proves nothing and its verdict is easy to read past in a summary. The harness now fails the run and lists the offenders.
